    THE ADVENTURER’S HANDBOOK

    Focus is your superpower.

    1. Choose your quest. Set 1–240 whole minutes. Each study second becomes 1 boss HP.
    2. Stay and study. Your hero attacks once per second. The boss’s HP and the timer fall together.
    3. Rest without a penalty. Pause whenever you need. Paused time never counts as study time.
    4. Pause before you leave. Switching to another tab or app, minimizing, reloading, or closing during a running raid causes defeat. Browsing the journal inside this app is safe.
    5. Win your loot. Completed study raids earn 10 EXP and 5 gold per minute. Every 500 EXP is a new level. Failed raids keep their focus time, but earn no loot.
    6. Build your streak. Win at least one real raid each local calendar day. Multiple wins in one day count once; a missed day resets the streak.

    Practice runs last 10 seconds and give no EXP, gold, or streak credit. Saves stay on this browser, with no account or cloud sync. Browser or device crashes are recorded as defeat when a running save is reopened. In rare cases, up to one second since the last save may be lost.
